title: Step 1 scaffold support: frontend rebuild diagnostics + declaration alignment

requirements.summary: Document the exact canister deployment failure root cause and align frontend build/declarations after the backend fix is applied.
acceptanceCriteria: A single, concrete root cause is documented (not a hypothesis), including the file and symbol/line area implicated when applicable
The project builds successfully locally in the build pipeline after the fix in REQ-4 is applied
If the failure is due to Candid mismatch, the generated frontend declarations align with the backend interface after rebuild

file_operations.description: Create a build/deploy incident note capturing the exact failing step and full error output from a clean rebuild/deploy attempt, plus the confirmed single root cause (including implicated file and symbol/line when applicable) and the verification steps after the REQ-4 backend fix is applied.

Add a short, repeatable clean-rebuild checklist focused on frontend + generated declarations alignment (e.g., when to regenerate declarations and what to verify in the UI build) so future Candid/interface mismatches are caught and resolved during rebuild.

If the deployment failure is caused by a Candid/interface mismatch, update the frontend backend type declarations to match the rebuilt backend interface (including any newly added/changed public methods/types) and ensure TypeScript compilation succeeds.
